tasks.short: Supervise equipment removal and site restoration

steps.what: Review the actual exhausted-well removal and restoration plan, assigned work and site status in oilfield operations software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual well/site identity, approved removal and restoration plan
actual responsible crews and site status
outputs: engineer's reviewed actual removal/restoration scope and issues

steps.what: Supervise the removal of drilling equipment, removal of waste and safe return of land to structural stability; inspect actual progress and direct necessary corrections
inputs: engineer's reviewed actual removal/restoration scope and issues
actual equipment, waste, land conditions and crew work
outputs: actual observed removal/restoration progress, unresolved conditions and directions

steps.what: Record actual supervised removal/restoration progress, unresolved conditions and directions and check the complete site log and destination
inputs: actual observed removal/restoration progress, unresolved conditions and directions
actual site/work-order identifiers
outputs: exact checked removal/restoration site log and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked removal/restoration site log in its intended internal work-order revision
inputs: exact checked removal/restoration site log and internal destination
outputs: saved actual removal/restoration site log

tasks.design: Configure a native well/work-order view and fixed site identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer supervises actual removal and restoration, records only observed progress and checks the completed site log before saving; no system declares the land stable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site-plan navigation and repeated work-order context can interrupt actual supervision records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native oilfield work-order views can retain actual site context.
tasks.still_hard: Structural stability, waste conditions and the quality of crew work require actual inspection and expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Stop or redirect work when real conditions differ from the restoration plan.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated context handling in an actual logged supervision episode.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with the site owner and work-order administrator

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native oilfield work-order context can reduce repeated log handling while site restoration supervision and stability judgments remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual logged supervision episode. No new completion report, stability certificate or waste shipment filing is added to the baseline.
The site planner supplies the actual plan and crews/status; the engineer produces observations in s2 and captures/checks them in s3. No sensor feed or structured completion flags are assumed.
Reuse only fixed well/work-order identity and existing views. Missing status remains unknown; no model certifies restoration. Equivalent native configuration removes the gain.

Shares 15/70/14/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 1.5 + 2.8 = 4.3; 1 hour of view/context upkeep leaves 3.3 net. Negligible same-system save remains fully counted and earns no saving.
Live directions are human conversations, not an automated equipment command. Final log checking is ordinary recording work; edits require a new check.
unknowns: Actual site log requirement and existing native work-order context
research_questions: Observe which repeated identifiers and plan searches occur during supervision.

already_counted.description: Plan review, site supervision and actual observation capture/checking remain.

incremental.description: Maintain actual site views and work-order context defaults.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked removal/restoration site log and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured opportunity below provisional 3.3 percent net, conditional on actual log/context work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather actual equipment condition, available installation/maintenance windows, assigned crews and dependencies from oilfield work orders
inputs: actual equipment work orders and condition records
actual operations and crew availability maintained by responsible planners
outputs: engineer-checked equipment work and availability set

steps.what: Resolve actual dependencies and choose the workable installation, maintenance and operating sequence for mining and oil field equipment
inputs: engineer-checked equipment work and availability set
actual engineering and operating constraints
outputs: engineer's feasible equipment work sequence and unresolved constraints

steps.what: Coordinate the installation, maintenance and operation of mining and oil field equipment with actual operations, crews and maintainers
inputs: engineer's feasible equipment work sequence and unresolved constraints
actual crew and operations responses
outputs: actual agreed equipment arrangements and unresolved conflicts

steps.what: Enter the actual agreed equipment assignments and dates, resolve missing fields and check the complete work-order update and destination
inputs: actual agreed equipment arrangements and unresolved conflicts
actual work-order, equipment and crew identifiers
outputs: exact checked equipment work-order update and internal destination

steps.what: Commit the exact checked equipment work-order update within the engineer's actual coordination authority
inputs: exact checked equipment work-order update and internal destination
outputs: saved actual equipment coordination revision

tasks.design: Configure native equipment/work-order and availability views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the oilfield maintenance and operations planner. Reuse actual selected work-order and crew identifiers during entry, while the engineer resolves dependencies, coordinates with people and checks the final update before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment coordination can involve repeated record navigation and re-entry of stable work-order context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native maintenance planners can expose existing linked equipment and crew records.
tasks.still_hard: Availability conflicts, operating constraints and agreement with actual crews remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a sequence that is feasible in the planner but unsuitable at the site.

ambition.what: Reduce duplicate record handling around actual coordination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with operations, maintainers and the planner administrator

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance-planning views and fixed context can reduce coordination record handling without deciding actual equipment sequencing or crew agreement.

assumptions: Responsible planners maintain real work-order and availability records. The engineer collects and checks those in s1, produces actual agreements in s3 and captures/checks them in s4; no structured agreement or availability feed is invented.
Native linked views/context first. Missing availability or unconfirmed dates stay unresolved for actual coordination; no model makes assignments or assumes a crew accepted.
This is actual work-order coordination, not an added status report. No hidden notifications, purchasing, operating commands or commissioning releases are proposed.

Shares 20/25/30/24/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 6 + 7.2 = 13.2; 2 hours of configuration upkeep leaves 11.2 net. Existing equivalent views/reuse remove the gain; the negligible commit is fully retained.
The engineer checks the actual final update and destination in ordinary record preparation. Any changed assignments require renewed checking before commit.
unknowns: Existing linked work-order views and actual repeated fields
research_questions: Measure duplicate record handling separately from live coordination and dependency resolution.

already_counted.description: Source checking, sequencing, live coordination and final record preparation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain linked equipment/crew context and planner configuration.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked equipment work-order update and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 11.2 percent net; actual human coordination remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish the actual mining or oil field machinery/tool requirements, operating loads and constraints
inputs: actual machinery problem and operating evidence
actual design constraints and engineering requirements
outputs: engineer-defined machinery design requirements and unresolved inputs

steps.what: Design or modify mining and oil field machinery and tools, applying engineering principles to the actual load paths, materials and operating conditions
inputs: engineer-defined machinery design requirements and unresolved inputs
actual equipment geometry and engineering evidence
outputs: engineer's proposed machinery/tool concept, calculations and trade-offs

steps.what: Construct the actual machinery CAD model/drawing and analysis setup using checked standard parts and drawing conventions
inputs: engineer's proposed machinery/tool concept, calculations and trade-offs
actual approved standard-part library and drawing conventions
outputs: actual machinery design model/drawing and analysis results

steps.what: Check the complete machinery design, calculations, interfaces, assumptions and intended internal revision against the actual requirements
inputs: actual machinery design model/drawing and analysis results
engineer-defined machinery design requirements and unresolved inputs
outputs: exact checked machinery design package, limitations and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked machinery design package in its intended internal engineering revision
inputs: exact checked machinery design package, limitations and internal destination
outputs: saved actual machinery design revision

tasks.design: Configure native checked standard-part and drawing/analysis setup reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the machinery CAD/engineering application. The engineer designs the real modification, checks the full model and calculations and saves the final internal revision; there is no automatic fabrication or field deployment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated standard-part insertion and drawing/analysis setup can surround the actual engineering design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parametric libraries and drawing profiles can reuse approved fixed elements.
tasks.still_hard: Operating loads, wear, interfaces and design validity depend on actual equipment evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an engineering modification that addresses the actual field problem.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated model setup while preserving machinery design decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD libraries can reuse standard machinery elements and setup; engineering requirements, trade-offs and verification remain human work.

assumptions: Operations provides actual field evidence and geometry. The engineer captures requirements in s1, creates the concept/calculations in s2 and constructs/checks the model in s3/s4. No complete structured load model is assumed.
Reuse only checked parts and setup conventions. Unknown loads, missing geometry or unsuitable library parts require manual engineering; no model invents values or validity.
Shares 20/40/25/14/1 are unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 25 times 0.30 = 7.5; 2 hours of library upkeep leaves 5.5 net. Existing equivalent reuse and solver runtime earn no new saving.
The negligible save is fully retained. Final engineering checking is actual design work, not a new self-approval process; changed design or destination requires a new check.
unknowns: Actual standard-part reuse and repeated model setup
research_questions: Which native CAD setup operations remain manual in real machinery changes?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, actual engineering and complete model verification remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and check native machinery standard-part/setup profiles.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked machinery design package, limitations and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 5.5 percent net; actual engineering work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Experiment on mining and oil machinery

steps.what: Design the actual engineering research experiment to improve or modify mining and oil machinery and operations
inputs: actual machinery/operations research question and prior evidence
actual measurement and operating constraints
outputs: engineer's actual experiment method, measurement plan and acceptance questions

steps.what: Set up the actual experiment and check the final method, equipment configuration, instruments and physical readiness before running it
inputs: engineer's actual experiment method, measurement plan and acceptance questions
actual authorized test equipment, instruments and test conditions
outputs: exact checked experiment method/configuration and current physical readiness

steps.what: Conduct the actual engineering research experiment on mining and oil machinery and operations under the checked method and configuration
inputs: exact checked experiment method/configuration and current physical readiness
actual test machinery and measurement instruments
outputs: actual instrument measurement export and engineer-observed experiment conditions

steps.what: Select the actual instrument export and verify run identity, units, channels and missing measurements against the actual experiment
inputs: actual instrument measurement export and engineer-observed experiment conditions
outputs: checked actual run export, channel/unit map and missing-data notes

steps.what: Import the checked instrument measurements through fixed run/channel/unit mappings into the analysis workspace and reject unsupported rows
inputs: checked actual run export, channel/unit map and missing-data notes
outputs: mapped actual experiment dataset with source references and rejected rows

steps.what: Resolve rejected rows, check imported measurements, perform and interpret the actual analysis, write findings/limits and check the complete experiment record and destination
inputs: mapped actual experiment dataset with source references and rejected rows
engineer's actual experiment method, measurement plan and acceptance questions
actual instrument measurement export and engineer-observed experiment conditions
outputs: exact checked experiment record, analysis, findings/limits and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked engineering experiment record in its intended internal research revision
inputs: exact checked experiment record, analysis, findings/limits and internal destination
outputs: saved actual machinery research experiment record

tasks.design: Configure a native instrument-export import profile and recurring analysis layout in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the experiment data/engineering analysis application. The engineer designs and conducts the actual experiment, verifies imported measurements and interprets/checks every finding before the separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual test exports may be re-keyed or repeatedly arranged for engineering analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fixed-field imports and analysis layouts can reuse known run/channel mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Experimental validity, setup quality, unexpected behavior and engineering interpretation require actual work.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a real machinery response from a measurement or setup artefact.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated data transfer and analysis setup in actual experiments.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with the test owner and instrument data custodian

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed instrument-export imports and native analysis layouts can reduce repeated data transfer/setup while experiments, source verification and engineering conclusions remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual authorized instrumented experiment with an existing CSV-like export. Instruments produce measured values in s3; the engineer produces observed conditions and checks the source in s4. No new sensor or structured dataset is supplied for free.

Import requires actual run ID, channel, unit, value and source version. Unknown schemas, missing keys, unit conflicts and rejected rows stop for manual handling in s6. The import only creates a draft analysis dataset, not a system-of-record update.

The s6 reduction covers repeated analysis-layout setup only. Actual imported-value checks, rejected-row handling, scientific interpretation, writing and complete final verification remain. Existing solver/statistics runtime earns no saving.

Native profiles first. Existing equivalent import/layout removes the gain. Shares 20/20/25/5/10/19/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 10 + 5.7 = 15.7; 2 hours of profile upkeep leaves 13.7 net. Negligible save is fully retained.
Any method/configuration change invalidates physical readiness and returns to s2. Final record edits return to s6. No automatic operating change or field deployment is promised.
unknowns: Actual instrument export availability and currently manual transfer/setup
research_questions: Measure repeated experiment data entry versus source checking and interpretation after native import.

already_counted.description: Experiment design, readiness, physical conduct, source checking and final analysis/record verification remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and verify instrument mappings and recurring analysis layouts.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked experiment method/configuration and current physical readiness
exact checked experiment record, analysis, findings/limits and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 13.7 percent net; physical experimentation and full findings checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Less repeated handling around actual petroleum engineering, with physical supervision and engineering conclusions retained.
